# `aitbc coin-requests request`

Request a one-time initial coin grant from the hub for a local wallet. This is the follower-side entry point: it registers the request with the hub, and, if the hub's coin-request policy auto-approves it, executes it immediately.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests request [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | `default` | no | Wallet name to receive the coins. |
| `--amount` | integer | `3` | no | Amount in AIT. |
| `--sender` | text | — | no | Sender id (defaults to hostname-wallet-suffix). |
| `--recipient` | text | `hub-coordinator` | no | Recipient agent id. |
| `--request-id` | text | — | no | Request id (defaults to a unique value). |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests request
```
